translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Aad'd'eeda eranchcha mishirata bare golliyaa kees's'aw; shin boozata bare golliyaa bare kushiyan kolaw.
Suure hamettiyaa Asay Med'inaa Godaw yayyee; shin bare ogiyaa geellayiyaa asay Med'inaa Godaa kad'ee.
Booza haasayay Aa zokkiyaw S'am"aa ayee; shin aad'd'eeda eranchchatuwaa ins's'arssay unttuntta naagee.
Booratuu bayinna saan yeesii mela de'ee; shin new goshiyaa wolk'k'aama booratuu de'ooppe, ne yeesiyaan katsay kumee.
Ammanettiyaa markkay ubbaa gede tumuwaa odee; shin wordduwaa markkay wordduwaa s'alala haasayee.
K'iliic'iyaawe aad'd'eeda eratetsaa koyee; shin demmenna; akeekay de'iyaa Asay eratetsaa demmanawe Aa waayissenna.
Booza asaappe haakka; ayaw gooppe, neeni Aa haasayaappe eraa demmakka.
C'inc'c'a Asay bare ootsiyaawaa eriyaa diraw, aad'd'eeda eranchcha; shin booza Asay ayinne erennankka eriyaawaa malatiyaa diraw c'immee.
Boozatuu nagaraa ootsiide, kayyottiyaawaa aggiide k'iliic'iino; shin suuretuu barenttu nagaray atto geetettanawaa koyiino.
Bare wozanaa kayyuwaa izaawu eree; Aa nashechchaakka ooninne aanana kos's'enna.
Iitatuwaa Gollii kolettenna; shin suuretuwaa gollii minniide de'ana.
Asaw likke malatiyaa ogii de'ee; shin biina, Aa wurssetsay hayk'k'uwaan kessi yeggee.
Miichchankka wozanay kayyotti eree; nashshechchaa wurssetsaykka kayyuwaa gidanaw danddayee.
Iita Asay bare iita oosuwaa gatiyaa akkana; lo"o asaykka bare lo"o oosuwaa gatiyaa akkana.
Booza Asay ubbaa ammanee; shin c'inc'c'ay akeekiide tanggee.
Aad'd'eeda eranchcha asay Med'inaa Godaa yayyee; iitaappekka haakkee; shin boozay alaalle geenanne elleellee.
Elle hank'k'ettiyaa asatuu booza oosuwaa ootsiino. Shin c'inc'c'atuu danddayanchcha.
Boozatuu barenttu boozatetsaa gatiyaa akkiino; shin c'inc'c'atuu eratetsaa kallachchaadan wotsanawantta.
Iita asatuu lo"o asatuwaa sintsan hokkiide, maarotaa woosana. Nagaranchchatuukka s'illotuwaa penggiyaan hokkana.
Hiyyeesay bare shooruwankka dosettenna; shin duretoo daro laggetuu de'iino.
Bare shooruwaa kad'iyaa Asay nagaraa ootsee; shin hiyyeesaa maaddiyaawe anjjetteedawaa.
Iitabaa mak'ettiyaawanttu baliino gidikkinoo? Shin lo"obaa ootsanaw halchchiyaawanttu tumatetsaanne aggena siik'uwaa demmiino.
Minniide ootsiyaawaan ubbaan go"ay de'ee; shin c'oo mela haasayay hiyeesatetsaa s'alala ayee.
Aad'd'eeda eranchchatoo unttunttu duretetsay kallachchaa; shin boozatuu barenttu boozatetsaa gujji gujjiide booziino.
Tumu markkay shemppuwaa ashshee; shin wordduwaa markkay baletsee.
Med'inaa Godaw yayyiyaa uraw mino geessuu de'ee. I Aa naanatookka bak'atiide attiyaa sa'aa gidanawaa.
Med'inaa Godaw yayyiyaawe de'uwaa pultto; hewaa diraw, Med'inaa Godaw yayiyaawe hayk'k'uwaa p'iriyaappe ashee.
Kaatiyaa gitatetsay I mooddiyaa asaa c'oratetsaana; shin I mooddiyaa Asay d'ayooppe, ikka patsenna.
Danddayanchcha asaw wolk'k'aama akeekay de'ee; shin elle hank'k'ettiyaa Asay bare boozatetsaa k'onc'c'issee.
Woppu geedda wozanay bollaa pas'a wotsee; shin k'anaatii bollaw ajaajjiyaa harggiyaa mala.
Hiyyeesatuwaa naak'k'iyaa Asay unttuntta Med'd'eeddawaa c'ashee; shin metootanchchatoo keekkiyaa Asay S'oossaa bonchchee.
Iitatuu barenttu iita oosuwaan kunddana; shin s'illotuu barenttu suuretetsan hayk'k'uwaappe naagettana.
Akeekanchcha asaa wozanaan aad'd'eeda eratetsay kumeedda; shin boozatuu aad'd'eeda eratetsaa ayaanne erikkino.
S'illotetsay itti kawutetsaa asaa d'ok'k'u d'ok'k'u ootsee; shin nagaray ay asanne kawushshee.
Kaatii eranchcha k'ooman nashettee; shin yeellayiyaa oosuwaa ootsiyaa k'oomaa hank'k'ettee.
